settlement_source: League/association governing the achievement (NCAA/CFP), AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports
settlement_variable: First official final result of the College Football Playoff National Championship Game (champion participant)
tie_handling: If multiple participants reported as result: each Yes gets $1/N rounded down to cent, No gets $1 minus Yes payout.
rounding: Round down to nearest cent for split payouts; tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: Listed close 2027-02-23T04:00Z (placeholder; title game ~Jan 2027); can_close_early=1; settlement_timer 300s; expiration 10:00 AM ET; first-official-result rule, later revisions ignored.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Final event postponed: sooner of result or 2 weeks after scheduled date (2 years if date unknown). Suspended during: sooner of result or 2 years. Cancelled/no result: eligible participants pay Yes at last traded price; if unfair, Outcome Review Committee; fallback equal split $1/N. Withdrawal, disqualification or elimination (as reported by Source Agency) -> No, even before final. Truncated event with reported result stands. Review at Exchange discretion (Rule 6.3(d)).
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'Will X win the CFP National Championship?' - rules resolve No as soon as team is reported eliminated, so per-team market can settle before the final.
Disqualification/withdrawal -> No even if team later reinstated (new market created).
Terms PDF is a generic ACHIEVEMENTS template for all sports; Appendix B bans current AND former players/staff while series metadata lists only current.
Cancellation pays last traded price, not $0.
toxicity_flags: Long-dated futures, many strikes mostly at 0-3c with wide relative spreads
Per-team market jumps to zero on elimination, public feed sub-minute
Injury/transfer/CFP selection news leaks before public
Near-zero price levels: tick size and fee drag dominate
Exchange discretionary outcome review on cancellation
notes: Sample KXNCAAF-27-WAKE, KXNCAAF-27-UTAH. Terms: NCAAF.pdf (ACHIEVEMENTS template). Middle of PDF not read. Retrieved 2026-11-01 PT.
